summary: Aflac Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) to offer three series of senior unsecured notes in unspecified principal amounts, maturing on unspecified dates, with interest paid semi-annually. The notes rank equally with existing unsecured senior debt, are not listed on any exchange, and are sold in minimum denominations of €100,000. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. Joint book-running managers include Mizuho, SMBC Nikko, Morgan Stanley, and MUFG. No special-situation event—this is an ordinary debt shelf takedown.
